item.title: After Years Of Remote Work, Toronto’s Office Market Is Heating Up
item.description: In early January, the Ford government’s return-to-office (RTO) mandate took effect, ordering 60,000 public servants back to the office. item.title: Bank Of Canada Holds Interest Rate Steady In First 2026 Announcement
item.description: On Wednesday, the Bank of Canada held its policy rate at 2.25%, following a series of cuts in 2025 that brought the benchmark overnight rate to its current level. Leading up to the announcement, many major Canadian banks — including RBC, TD, and CIBC — came into 2026 expecting the Bank to maintain a steady policy stance. item.title: How Canadian Developers Are Building For 2026 (And Beyond)
item.description: It’s no secret that Canada’s homebuilding sector has weathered a few tough years.
